write_scope: This one new review directory plus fresh required private/workflow/checks directories only. Input/executor/queue/projections untouched.

measurement.basis: Observed initial setup UTC to final seal construction; elapsed wall time, not measured active/operator time.

self_exclusion_policy: Seal excludes itself. This direct invocation writes no subsequent files in this attempt; final seal hash is returned through tool output/operator handoff. All frozen review files remain immutable.
stop: Independent findings frozen. Coordinator decides repairs/acceptance separately. No downstream task or other session/agent/automation/message.
